description: Opinionated starting templates for setting up an organization's inventory: per kind of organization a proven category tree with custom field definitions, typical locations, quantity-tracked consumable examples and setup-interview guidance. Without arguments: the template catalog (id, title, org-type fit, summary) plus how to choose. With templateId: the full template — structured slices whose shapes match the scaffold_categories / scaffold_locations inputs, names as {en, de, fr, es, it} records, prose guidance for you. Fetch the fitting template EARLY in a setup conversation (after get_setup_status), then ADAPT it with your user — pick the org's language, rename to their vocabulary, prune what they don't have — and commit through the scaffold tools' preview-then-confirm flow. The template is expertise, not a script: never pipe it unchanged without your user's input.
